title: skills: stop teaching `inlineEdit: true` on master-detail relationships (follow-up of #35926)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

PR #36802 (Fixes #35926) retires the boolean arm of `inlineEdit` on master-detail relationships. Since #35889, the parent object's field groups (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`) decide whether a child list renders inline, so `true` and `false` mean the same as leaving the key out. The parse now refuses both booleans with a fix hint, and `os migrate meta` strips them.

The skills text still teaches the retired value, at two sites on main:

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:285` teaches `inlineEdit: true` as "auto".
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json:439` says "`true` or absent picks by the child's shape".

## Ask

Rewrite both sites to teach the field-group rule. `inlineEdit` takes only `'grid'` / `'form'`, or is omitted. A child list goes inline through the parent's `fieldGroups[].relatedList`.

## Release coupling

`@objectstack/skills` is in the same fixed changeset group as `@objectstack/spec`. This card must therefore land before the release that publishes #36802's narrowing. If it lands later, the published skill teaches a value the published parse refuses.

Source: Contract review 7138399935 and seat record 7138432732 on PR #36802.
